statement: The function returns a result r (a Vec of i64) such that: (a) len(r) = k; (b) there exist indices i_0 < i_1 < ... < i_{k-1} in [0, len(nums)-1] with r[j] = nums[i_j] for all 0 <= j < k; (c) for every subsequence s of nums of length k, r is lexicographically less than or equal to s, where lexicographic comparison means r = s or there exists an index p with 0 <= p < k such that r[p] < s[p] and for all q < p, r[q] = s[q].
preconditions: 1 <= len(nums) <= 10^5, for all i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 0 <= nums[i] <= 10^9, and 1 <= k <= len(nums).

statement: The function returns a result r with len(r) = k.
preconditions: 1 <= len(nums) <= 10^5, for all i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 0 <= nums[i] <= 10^9, and 1 <= k <= len(nums).

statement: The function returns a result r such that len(r) = k and there exist indices i_0 < i_1 < ... < i_{k-1} in [0, len(nums)-1] with r[j] = nums[i_j] for all 0 <= j < k.
preconditions: 1 <= len(nums) <= 10^5, for all i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 0 <= nums[i] <= 10^9, and 1 <= k <= len(nums).

statement: The function returns a result r such that len(r) = k and for every subsequence s of nums of length k, r is lexicographically less than or equal to s (i.e., r = s or there exists an index p with 0 <= p < k such that r[p] < s[p] and for all q < p, r[q] = s[q]).
preconditions: 1 <= len(nums) <= 10^5, for all i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 0 <= nums[i] <= 10^9, and 1 <= k <= len(nums).

statement: The function returns a result r such that for every j with 0 <= j < len(r), 0 <= r[j] <= 10^9.
preconditions: 1 <= len(nums) <= 10^5, for all i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 0 <= nums[i] <= 10^9, and 1 <= k <= len(nums).

statement: The function returns a result r with len(r) = 1 and r[0] = min{ nums[i] : 0 <= i < len(nums) }. Equivalently, r[0] <= nums[i] for all 0 <= i < len(nums), and there exists an index i with r[0] = nums[i].
preconditions: 1 <= len(nums) <= 10^5, for all i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 0 <= nums[i] <= 10^9, 1 <= k <= len(nums), and k = 1.

statement: The function returns a result r with len(r) = len(nums) and for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), r[i] = nums[i].
preconditions: 1 <= len(nums) <= 10^5, for all i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 0 <= nums[i] <= 10^9, 1 <= k <= len(nums), and k = len(nums).

statement: The function returns a result r with len(r) = k and for every j with 0 <= j < k, r[j] = v.
preconditions: 1 <= len(nums) <= 10^5, for all i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 0 <= nums[i] <= 10^9, 1 <= k <= len(nums), and there exists a value v such that for all i with 0 <= i < len(nums), nums[i] = v.

statement: The function returns a result r such that len(r) = k and r[0] = min{ nums[i] : 0 <= i <= len(nums) - k }.
preconditions: 1 <= len(nums) <= 10^5, for all i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 0 <= nums[i] <= 10^9, and 1 <= k <= len(nums).

statement: For every nums and k satisfying the preconditions, the function returns a result (i.e., it does not panic, overflow, or go out of bounds).
preconditions: 1 <= len(nums) <= 10^5, for all i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 0 <= nums[i] <= 10^9, and 1 <= k <= len(nums).

statement: The function returns a result r such that len(r) = k and for every subsequence s of nums of length k, if s != r then r is lexicographically strictly less than s (i.e., there exists an index p with 0 <= p < k such that r[p] < s[p] and for all q < p, r[q] = s[q]).
preconditions: 1 <= len(nums) <= 10^5, for all i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 0 <= nums[i] <= 10^9, and 1 <= k <= len(nums).

statement: The function returns a result r with len(r) = k and for every j with 0 <= j < k, r[j] = nums[j].
preconditions: 1 <= len(nums) <= 10^5, for all i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 0 <= nums[i] <= 10^9, 1 <= k <= len(nums), and nums is non-decreasing (for all i < j with 0 <= i < j < len(nums), nums[i] <= nums[j]).

statement: The function returns a result r with len(r) = k and for every j with 0 <= j < k, r[j] = nums[len(nums) - k + j].
preconditions: 1 <= len(nums) <= 10^5, for all i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 0 <= nums[i] <= 10^9, 1 <= k <= len(nums), and nums is non-increasing (for all i < j with 0 <= i < j < len(nums), nums[i] >= nums[j]).
